## Color Palette Generator

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live swatches</span></div>

Generate harmonious color palettes from a base color: complementary, analogous, triadic, tetradic, monochromatic, shades, tints and a 50–950 scale.

```sh
dogubako design palette <color> [options]
```

Id `design.palette` · MCP `design_palette` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: palette, color scheme, complementary, analogous, triadic, monochromatic, shades, tints, harmony

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` *(required)* | positional | color | `#3366ff` | Base color. |
| `scheme` | `--scheme` | choice | `complementary` | One of: `complementary`, `split_complementary` (Split complementary), `analogous`, `triadic`, `tetradic` (Tetradic (rectangle)), `square`, `monochromatic`, `shades` (Shades (darker)), `tints` (Tints (lighter)), `tones` (Tones (grayer)), `scale` (50–950 scale). |
| `count` | `--count` | integer 2–20 | `5` | Number of colors for monochromatic/shades/tints/tones. |

## Extract Palette from Image

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live swatches</span></div>

Extract a color palette from an image, with percentages, CSS variables and a swatch image.

```sh
dogubako design palette-extract <file> [options]
```

Id `design.palette_extract` · MCP `design_palette_extract` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: palette, extract colors, color picker, image colors, swatches, theme from image

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | file |  | Image. Accepts image/\*, .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .bmp +31 more. |
| `count` | `--count` | integer 2–16 | `6` |  |
| `sort` | `--sort` | choice | `share` | One of: `share` (By share of image), `lightness` (By lightness), `hue` (By hue). |

## Contrast Checker

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live swatches</span></div>

Check WCAG 2.x contrast between text and background colors (AA/AAA, normal and large text) and get passing suggestions.

```sh
dogubako design contrast <foreground> --background <background>
```

Id `design.contrast` · MCP `design_contrast` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: contrast, wcag, accessibility, a11y, aa, aaa, color contrast, readability

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `foreground` *(required)* | positional | color | `#777777` | Text color. |
| `background` *(required)* | `--background` | color | `#ffffff` | Background color. |

## Gradient Generator

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span></div>

Create CSS linear, radial or conic gradients from color stops and render them as PNG.

```sh
dogubako design gradient <stops> [options]
```

Id `design.gradient` · MCP `design_gradient` · Output: files, plus `text/plain` text · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: gradient, css gradient, linear-gradient, radial, background, wallpaper

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stops` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) | `#ff7e5f, #feb47b` | Color stops. |
| `kind` | `--kind` | choice | `linear` | One of: `linear`, `radial`, `conic`. |
| `angle` | `--angle` | number -360–360 | `90` | Angle (°). Only used when `kind` is one of `linear`, `conic`. |
| `width` | `--width` | integer 1–8000 | `1200` |  |
| `height` | `--height` | integer 1–8000 | `630` |  |

## Aspect Ratio Calculator

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live</span></div>

Calculate the aspect ratio of a size, or the missing width/height for a given ratio.

```sh
dogubako design aspect-ratio [options]
```

Id `design.aspect_ratio` · MCP `design_aspect_ratio` · Output: structured data · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: aspect ratio, ratio, 16:9, resolution, dimensions, calculator, scale

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | `--width` | integer ≥ 1 |  | Original width. |
| `height` | `--height` | integer ≥ 1 |  | Original height. |
| `ratio` | `--ratio` | text |  | Use this ratio instead of width × height. |
| `target_width` | `--target-width` | integer ≥ 1 |  | New width → compute height. |
| `target_height` | `--target-height` | integer ≥ 1 |  | New height → compute width. |

## Resize Canvas / Pad

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>progress</span></div>

Extend or trim the canvas around images to an exact size, an aspect ratio or by padding, with a color or transparent fill.

```sh
dogubako design canvas-resize <files…> [options]
```

Id `design.canvas_resize` · MCP `design_canvas_resize` · Output: files · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: canvas, pad, padding, border, extend, letterbox, square, instagram, frame

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | files |  | Images. Accepts image/\*, .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .bmp +31 more. |
| `mode` | `--mode` | choice | `aspect` | One of: `aspect` (To aspect ratio), `size` (To exact size), `padding` (Add padding). |
| `aspect` | `--aspect` | text | `1:1` | Aspect ratio. Only used when `mode` is `aspect`. |
| `width` | `--width` | integer ≥ 1 |  | Only used when `mode` is `size`. |
| `height` | `--height` | integer ≥ 1 |  | Only used when `mode` is `size`. |
| `padding` | `--padding` | integer 0–10000 | `50` | Pixels on every side. Only used when `mode` is `padding`. |
| `anchor` | `--anchor` | choice | `center` | Where the original sits on the new canvas. One of: `center`, `top-left` (Top left), `top`, `top-right` (Top right), `left`, `right`, `bottom-left` (Bottom left), `bottom`, `bottom-right` (Bottom right). |
| `background` | `--background` | color | `#ffffff` | Fill color (#00000000 = transparent). |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `same` | One of: `same` (Same as input), `png`, `jpg` (JPEG), `webp`. *Advanced.* |

## Overlay Images

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span></div>

Place one image on top of another with position, scale, opacity and blend mode (multiply, screen, overlay...).

```sh
dogubako design compose <file> --overlay <overlay> [options]
```

Id `design.compose` · MCP `design_compose` · Output: files · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: overlay, compose, composite, layer, blend, superimpose, place logo

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` *(required)* | positional | file |  | Base image. Accepts image/\*, .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .bmp +31 more. |
| `overlay` *(required)* | `--overlay` | file |  | Overlay image. Accepts image/\*, .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .bmp +31 more. |
| `position` | `--position` | choice | `center` | One of: `center`, `top-left` (Top left), `top`, `top-right` (Top right), `left`, `right`, `bottom-left` (Bottom left), `bottom`, `bottom-right` (Bottom right), `custom` (Custom x/y). |
| `x` | `--x` | integer | `0` | Only used when `position` is `custom`. |
| `y` | `--y` | integer | `0` | Only used when `position` is `custom`. |
| `scale` | `--scale` | number 0–400 | `0` | Overlay width (% of base, 0 = original). |
| `opacity` | `--opacity` | number 0–1 | `1` |  |
| `blend` | `--blend` | choice | `normal` | One of: `normal`, `multiply`, `screen`, `overlay`, `darken`, `lighten`, `difference`, `add`. |
| `margin` | `--margin` | integer 0–10000 | `0` | *Advanced.* |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `png` | One of: `png`, `jpg` (JPEG), `webp`. |

## Styled QR Code

<div class="tool-meta"><span class="engine-native">native</span><span>live preview</span></div>

Design branded QR codes: colors, rounded or dot modules, styled eyes and a center logo (uses high error correction).

```sh
dogubako design qr-style <text> [options]
```

Id `design.qr_style` · MCP `design_qr_style` · Output: files · Timeout 2 min

Also found by: qr, qr code, logo, branded, custom, styled, dots, rounded

| Option | CLI | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` *(required)* | positional | text (multi-line) |  | Content. |
| `size` | `--size` | integer 64–4096 | `512` | Image size in pixels. |
| `error_correction` | `--error-correction` | choice | `M` | One of: `L` (Low (7%)), `M` (Medium (15%)), `Q` (Quartile (25%)), `H` (High (30%)). |
| `margin` | `--margin` | integer 0–20 | `4` | Quiet zone in modules (4 recommended). |
| `foreground` | `--foreground` | color | `#000000` |  |
| `background` | `--background` | color | `#ffffff` |  |
| `module_style` | `--module-style` | choice | `rounded` | One of: `square`, `rounded`, `dots`. |
| `eye_style` | `--eye-style` | choice | `rounded` | One of: `square`, `rounded`, `dots` (Rounded with dot). |
| `logo` | `--logo` | file |  | Logo (optional). Accepts image/\*, .png .jpg .jpeg .webp .gif .bmp +31 more. |
| `logo_size` | `--logo-size` | number 5–30 | `20` | Logo size (% of width). |
| `format` | `--format` | choice | `both` | One of: `both` (PNG + SVG), `png`, `svg`. *Advanced.* |
| `file_name` | `--file-name` | text | `qr-code` | *Advanced.* |
